name: N Candles v5
summary: This EA trades based on N consecutive candlestick patterns, detecting streaks of consecutive bullish or bearish candles to generate entry signals. It opens positions when a configurable number of consecutive same-direction candles are detected, expecting either trend continuation or reversal depending on settings. The EA includes customizable parameters for candle count, lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于N根连续K线形态进行交易，通过检测连续上涨或下跌蜡烛序列来产生入场信号。当检测到可配置数量的同方向连续K线时开仓，根据设置可做趋势延续或反转交易。EA包含蜡烛数量、手数、止损和止盈等可自定义参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于连续K线形态识别，即当市场出现N根同方向的连续蜡烛时视为交易信号。入场条件为检测到用户指定数量的连续阳线（看涨）或连续阴线（看跌）后开仓，可选择顺势交易或逆势交易模式。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈设置，同时可能包含跟踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供止损和止盈参数用于控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户风险控制和最大回撤保护机制。该策略假设连续K线序列具有统计意义的方向性偏向，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is based on consecutive candlestick pattern recognition, treating N successive same-direction candles as a trading signal. Entry conditions trigger when the EA detects a user-configured number of consecutive bullish or bearish candles, with options for trend-following or reversal mode. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings, and may include trailing stop functionality. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-based percentage calculation. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters for per-trade risk control, but lacks overall account risk management and maximum drawdown protection. The strategy assumes that consecutive candle sequences carry statistically significant directional bias, though it is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: N_Candles
parameters.description: 连续同方向K线数量阈值

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 跟踪止损点数，0为不启用

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单

parameters.name: TradeDirection
parameters.description: 交易方向：仅多/仅空/双向
parameters.description_en: Trade direction: long only / short only / both

parameters.name: ReversalMode
parameters.description: 是否启用反转模式（逆势交易）

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调优
基于价格行为而非滞后指标，反应速度较快
参数灵活可调，适应不同市场和时间周期
可切换顺势和逆势模式，提供策略多样性
连续K线形态具有市场心理学基础支撑
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and optimize
Based on price action rather than lagging indicators, providing faster response
Flexible parameters adaptable to different markets and timeframes
Switchable between trend-following and reversal modes, offering strategic diversity
Consecutive candle patterns have market psychology foundation
cons: 在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号
缺乏整体账户风险管理和最大回撤保护
止损止盈为固定值，未考虑ATR等动态波动率指标
连续K线判断未考虑蜡烛实体大小和影线比例
没有市场状态过滤器来区分趋势和震荡行情
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks overall account risk management and maximum drawdown protection
Stop loss and take profit are fixed values without dynamic ATR-based adjustment
Consecutive candle detection does not consider candle body size or wick ratio
No market state filter to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
添加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在震荡行情中减少交易频率
引入蜡烛实体大小和影线比例的过滤条件，提高信号质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for automatic risk parameter adjustment based on market volatility
Add market state filter (e.g., ADX or volatility threshold) to reduce trading frequency in ranging conditions
Introduce candle body size and wick ratio filtering conditions to improve signal quality

risk_points: 固定止损止盈无法适应不同波动率环境，低波动时止损过大高波动时止盈过小
缺乏账户级别风险控制如最大持仓数、最大回撤限制和日亏损限制
连续K线信号在震荡市中频繁触发可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit cannot adapt to varying volatility environments—stop too wide in low volatility, take profit too small in high volatility
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum open positions, maximum drawdown limit, and daily loss limit
Consecutive candle signals may trigger frequently in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
